result.brief: 提出基于多阶段持续学习的腹腔镜手术基础模型，学习多模态视觉表征并支持去烟、阶段识别、分割等多项任务。
result.reason: Medical laparoscopic foundation model learning multimodal visual representations via continual learning; representation contribution is domain-specific with unclear transfer to general video/world-model representation goals.
